title: Adaptive indemnity threshold simulator for pricing experiments and legal redline flow
creator: Priya Nair
description: Problem: Enterprise customers increasingly request tailored indemnity and liability caps during Dedicated/Private onboarding. Current manual review for MSA/DPA redlines is slow, creates pricing variance, and blocks large deals. Goal: build an experiment and tooling that lets Sales simulate priced outcomes given a set of indemnity/liability concessions, integrates legal triage recommendations, and outputs an actionable contract disposition plus suggested price delta.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Sales can run a 1-click simulation that shows the impact on ARR and unit economics for 3 indemnity slider positions (Standard / Moderate / Elevated). 2) Simulation surface includes: estimated price uplift, legal risk tag, recommended guardrail (auto-approve / require L&E review / escalate to Legal Lead), and suggested contract language snippets. 3) Legal triage recommendations are surfaced from a deterministic ruleset plus a preliminary ML classifier for clause complexity. 4) Simulation links to a prepopulated redline template and a GitHub PR stub or Legal intake ticket. 5) Telemetry emitted for every simulation and final customer decision for A/B analysis.
success_metrics: 1) Reduce median redline review time from 7 business days to <= 48 hours for auto-approvable concessions. 2) Increase SRR (sales-run-rate) of deals requiring indemnity concessions by 15% in experiment cohort. 3) Reduce variance in pricing adjustments (stddev) for MSA/DPA concessions by 30%.
risks_and_tradeoffs: - Risk of over-approving risky concessions if ruleset is too permissive; mitigation: conservative initial guardrails and manual review for first 50 sims. - Trade-off between expressiveness of simulation UI and speed of adoption by sales; prefer a simple 3-position slider rather than full clause editor initially. - Accuracy of clause-complexity classifier may be low at launch; include manual override and explicit logging for retraining.
implementation_notes: - Backend: extend pricing-sim service to accept indemnity parameters and return price delta via cost model. - Legal ruleset lives in legal-config repo as YAML representing auto-approve thresholds. - Frontend: add simulation modal in Sales Console with 3 sliders and an explanation tooltip. - Telemetry: capture input params, decision path, and final disposition event to analytics.pricing_experiments. - Security: KMS-protected storage for any customer-specific inputs in Private/Dedicated experiments.
